title: Semih Erden
wikitext:
'''Semih Erden''' (born [[July 28]] [[1986]] in [[Gaziosmanpaşa]], [[Istanbul]]) is a [[Turkey|Turkish]] professional [[basketball]] player for Turkish side [[Fenerbahçe Ülker]]. The [[power forward (basketball)|power forward]]/[[center (basketball)|center]] is 2.14 m tall and weighs 113 kg, and also wears the number-nine jersey for his squad.

He is currently listed as a late first round [[draft]] pick by some [[National Basketball Association|NBA]] scouts and [[General Manager|GMs]].{{fact|date=April 2008}}

==Career==
* 2003-04 [[Darüşşafaka S.K.]]
* 2004-05 [[KK Partizan]]
* 2005-06 [[Fenerbahçe Ülker|Fenerbahçe Istanbul]]
* 2005-pre [[Fenerbahçe Ülker]]

==Career highlights==
* Second place of Europe with U18 team
* Second place of Europe with U21 team
* 6th of World Cup with [[Turkey national basketball team]]
* Serbian Basketball League Champion (2005) with [[KK Partizan]]
* [[Turkish Basketball League]] Champion (2007) with [[Fenerbahçe Ülker|Fenerbahçe]]
* Turkish President's Cup Champion (2007) with [[Fenerbahçe Ülker|Fenerbahçe]]

==International career==
Semih Erden is regular [[Turkey national basketball team|Turkish national team]] player.
